class_descriptions.hello: Open hand waving or gesturing forward from forehead/temple
class_descriptions.thank_you: Flat hand moving forward from chin toward receiver
class_descriptions.yes: Closed fist tilting/nodding up and down
class_descriptions.no: Index and middle fingers tapping thumb repeatedly
class_descriptions.please: Open flat hand rubbing chest in a circular motion
class_descriptions.help: Thumbs-up resting on flat non-dominant palm moving upward
class_descriptions.sorry: Closed fist rubbing chest in small circular motion
class_descriptions.iloveyou: Hand with thumb, index, and pinky fingers extended
